style: Cinematic 3D render for a premium investigative documentary, stylized realism with clean matte materials, low-key lighting with deep violet-ink and charcoal shadows, a single cool ultraviolet key light as the only strong accent, soft volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, clearly separated foreground, midground and background layers, calm restrained mood, fine film grain. No text, no logos, no brand marks.
